Mobile Order is easy:
1. Sign in with Email, Facebook or Twitter
2. Choose a store
3. Pick the items you want
4. Choose pick up method (counter, take out or table delivery*)
5. Choose payment method (VISA, Mastercard, JCB, Diners or LINE Pay)
6. When you arrive at the restaurant, tap to confirm your payment and we will start preparing your order, fresh
* Table delivery is available at participating restaurants and during limited service hours. Drive-Thru is not supported. Please park your car, and pick up at the counter inside the store.

You can use loyalty point cards by logging in with your Rakuten ID or Docomo D Account from the ""Point Card"" button in the upper-right corner of the screen. 
- Log in with your Rakuten ID to use Rakuten Points
- Log in with your Docomo D account to use D Points
